notes: DiscoFlate v3.27.0 — Bonus amounts & teamwork Bonus Rounds. New award_amount action banks pump-seconds or capacity-% on a target; a new Bonus Round (teamwork) posts a Confirm button to bonus holders and, once all (or the top holder) confirm, cashes in the pooled [total_bonus_secs]/[total_bonus_pct] via your action block, then clears the banks. New action types: bonus_round, award_amount, session_leader_event (a Winner-Button locked to the session leader, with freeze + timer/fallback), and embed_message (title + body embed). New placeholders [total_bonus_secs]/[total_bonus_pct] and [user_bonus_secs]/[user_bonus_pct]. Winner buttons gained a titlebar field.
